Returns n limited to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** - Formats byte counts as human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB with one decimal place)
3. **`loadSettings(filePath)`** - Reads and parses JSON synchronously, applies defaults ({ theme: "dark", autosave: true }), and throws clear uppercase error codes (FILE_NOT_FOUND, FILE_READ_ERROR, JSON_PARSE_ERROR) when issues occur

All error messages follow the project convention of starting with an uppercase snake-case error code.
